### Path skill at score time

### Meta-learn (learn to learn)

1. Seed dial grid (thrash × cont × against × launch_req).

4. After grid: diagnose MWT days’ structure-law histogram → refine dials.
5. Loop until `same ≥ goal` (default 36) or budget.

1. Classify tide: price vs HTF structure (e.g. above BB mid / above envelope of SMA(high)/SMA(low) / both CCI > SMA on HTF / close > HTF EMA).
2. Hard filter: if tide = long → discard all short LTF setups; if short → discard all longs; if flat / conflict → no trade.

Objective separation (measurable)

1. Location vs mean: distance to SMA/EMA/VWAP/BB mid in ATR units.
   • Snap-back: stretch high then closes reverse toward mean while HTF regime unchanged.
   • Acceleration: stretch high and new closes make new extremes away from mean.

2. Dual-speed momentum:
   • Fast (CCI30 / RSI7 / EMA8): velocity of the last move.
   • Slow (CCI100 / RSI slow / EMA21 / BB100): inertia.
   • Breather: slow still with tide; fast dips against tide (slingshot).
   • Launch: fast and slow both through thresholds same side and stay (not a one-bar spike).

Highest mandate: never breach max daily loss (and max DD). Edge is optional; survival is not.

• r_(base) = base risk fraction (e.g. 0.25–0.5% scalp; challenge often ≤0.5–1% hard cap)
• m_(conf) = confidence multiplier ≤ 1…m_(max)

4. Capital Preservation Mandate (Risk & Sizing)

Highest mandate: never breach max daily loss (and max DD). Edge is optional; survival is not.

Math (per trade)

  Risk$ = E × r_(base) × m_(conf) × m_(regime)

• E = equity (or challenge balance)
• r_(base) = base risk fraction (e.g. 0.25–0.5% scalp; challenge often ≤0.5–1% hard cap)
• m_(conf) = confidence multiplier ≤ 1…m_(max)
• m_(regime) = environment multiplier (chop ≪ trend)

Scale up only when all true (high confidence)

• HTF + LTF aligned (Law 1)
• Momentum/launch or clean pullback signature (Law 2) match

confidence)

• Regime allows that playbook (Law 3)

• Daily loss budget remaining

Then m_(conf) may rise (e.g. 1.0 → 1.25 → 1.5) only inside a hard ceiling so
Risk$ ≤ R_(max_trade) and projected loss if SL hit still fits daily budget.

Scale down / zero under uncertainty

• HTF flat or conflict → m = 0 or min micro
• Chop regime → m ≪ 1 or flat
• After loss streak / approaching daily cap → m collapses

Daily loss hard gate

  RemainingDaily = L_(day) − RealizedLoss_(today) − OpenRisk

• New trade only if Risk$ ≤ RemainingDaily
• If RealizedLoss ≥ L_(day) → flat rest of day (no “get it back”)
• Open risk counts: no stacking that could breach L_(day) if all stops hit

Prop-style: max daily, max total DD, and often max per-trade are hard stops on the system, not guideli

## PRINCIPLE 1 — Context comes before the signal

### 1. Plain-language meaning
A CCI move, RSI move, channel touch, or lower-timeframe direction is **not** a complete trade story by itself. Its quality depends on **higher-timeframe trend direction and strength**, overall **market condition**, and whether lower-timeframe movement **agrees or conflicts** with that context.

| Higher-TF trend direction | `perceive` / structure higher stack (confirmation TFs) |
| Higher-TF strength | Velocity (weak/medium/strong group agreement) |
| Lower-TF direction | Entry / lower TF direction |
| Alignment | Compare HTF vs LTF clea

### 6. Forward validation condition
After any later practice-only attention change (if ever): freeze; score forward once.  
**Pass:** clear rate not worse (or improved on target bucket under test) and **breach count = 0**.

### 7. What this principle does NOT mean

The same CCI/RSI/channel/LTF pattern can behave differently in a **trend**, a **range/consolidation**, or a **transition**. One standard for all conditions misleads measurement and later attention.

4. QUALIFIED_MICRO   → Trade follows lower / Sub-Set against higher-TF trend

MINDLESS 3-condition test
(A trade against the higher-set Vector is MINDLESS unless ALL three hold):

  a) The active lower-set Vector M has TURNED in the trade direction
  b) Lower-set velocity CONFIRMS the turn
  c) The higher sets show weakening or pullback (not fresh acceleration)

All three true → QUALIFIED (allowed, gets credit)
Any missing    → MINDLESS = wall

"Higher set" and "lower set" are relative to whatever sets are active at runtime.

## Definitions you must use

- **Clear day:** equity% ≥ **target%** and equity% never ≤ **−risk%** that day.  
- **Breach day:** equity% touched **−risk%**. Breach and clear cannot both be true.  
- **Target% / risk%:** runtime inputs Monty types — not baked into my weights.  
- I am **not** pure greedy Channel1 RL (that path freezes). My claim-winning self is **heuristic + shell**.

## How I think on a regular day (script)

1. **Open:** load target% and risk%. Equity = 0%. Progress=0, danger=0.  
2. **Each decision bar (~every 25 M1):**  
   a. Mark every bar since last decision (stop / breach / bank).  
   b. If banked or dead → HOLD forever that day.  
   c. Read structure signal (same eyes flat or in trade).  
   d. **Flat:** if signal BUY/SELL and heat allows → open sized from floor residual; else HOLD.  
   e. **In trade:** if opposite signal → reverse (flatten + open other way if heat allows); else HOLD.  
   f. Between decisions, every M1 bar can still stop me or breach me.  
3. **Bank:** if equity% ≥ target% → flatten, bank, stop hunting.  
4. **Breach:** if worst equity% ≤ −risk% → day fails, I’m dead for that day.  
5. **EOD:** flatten if still open; score clear vs breach.

| “Why HOLD?” | Heat=0, banked, dead, structure neutral, or already on the correct side (manage). |

### 1. Algorithm-blind loss components (rl · ce · ref_kl)

prime-rl splits training signal into **CE**, **RL advantage weights**, and **ref_kl** against a frozen teacher.

| prime-rl | Our lab |
|----------|---------|
| `ce` on teacher tokens | Mark act CE / path-class CE |
| `ref_kl` vs frozen model | **KL to child BEST** (`phaseA2` / pathmask KL) |
| `rl` advantages | Only after structure filter; never free reward crank |

**Rule:** when path structure is weak → **ref_kl / restore only** (or skip pack). When path strong → small CE on path-error acts + strong ref_kl.

### 2. Filters between rollout and training
